posts.cooked: I know this has been discussed and done by others, but earlier this week we played The Matriarch in The Final Wasteland and the first environment card was Unforgiving Wasteland. We pretty quickly after that got two New Jersey Devils (each hit the lowest two non-environment targets). The Wraith also started with Smoke Bombs. The Naturalist first tanked a bunch and then made us immune to the environment. Plus we had Team Leader Tachyon. Easiest takedown of the Matriarch I've ever been a part of. More than half of The Matriarch's deck was taken out of the game. None of the heroes got below 20 HP, I think.

posts.name: Ameena
posts.cooked: Haha yeah cool - shortly after I got Shattered Timelines we deliberately fought Lilian in the Final Wasteland in the hopes that we could get all her birdies eaten. First environment card - Horrid Skunk Ape. Second - Unforgiving Wasteland. Next were the Bunker and then the Library, I believe. Then more monsters started coming out but the game didn't last too much longer past that point. All that remained of Lilian's deck by the end of the game were her five one-shots and one Carrion Field which had entered play at one point but been destroyed by us, then either didn't manage to come back into play again or did but wasn't destroyed again bfore the game ended. Either way it was a dead card due to the lack of Fowl :D.
